notes: Parent MODINE per page; related brands Airedale, Effinityy 93, Hot Dawg, Modine, Valedictorian are listed on the page but sharing of these serial systems is NOT verified, so no sisters or usesStylesOf are claimed. Caveat: the page's three nomenclature diagrams carry AAON filenames (Style-1/2/3_AAON-Date-of-Manufacture_Serial-Number-Nomenclature.png); the rules below are the text rules stated on the Atherion page itself, not the diagrams. Style 2 is year-only: its month-letter chart is image-only. Style 2 example discrepancy on the page: the style list shows '97 JKGK153' while the section header shows '97 JKGJ153'; the month letter (3rd position, J) is the same in both, and the file uses the list version.

styles.notes: Page example shown as '2001 08AKG26241'; normalized it is 200108AKG26241. Page positions 1-4 (1-based) = year, 5-6 = month, converted to 0-based half-open [0,4] and [4,6].

Page example shown as '97 JKGK153'; normalized it is 97JKGK153. Page positions 1-2 (1-based) = year digits, converted to [0,2]. Page position 3 (letter) = month via a chart that is image-only (Style-2_AAON diagram), so month is null here rather than guessed; month mapping is an image-pass item.

styles.era: 4 letters + digits, year/month in positions 6-9 (page Style 3)
styles.notes: Page example shown as 'AKEC087 01'; normalized it is AKEC08701. Page positions 6-7 (1-based) = year digits, 8-9 = month digits, converted to 0-based half-open [5,7] and [7,9].
